6.1 All dents, burrs and sharp edges shall be removed from various components and they shall be pickled, scrubbed and rinsed to remove grease, rust, scale or any other foreign matter. 6.2 Immediately after pickling, all mild steeJ parts shall be given phosphating treatment in accordance with IS 3618 : 1966, followed by a coat of suitable primer, such as red oxide ( see Note ).
NOTE - Putty shall be applied to all the surfaces requiring filling coat with enamel conforming to IS 110 : 1983. Aluminium primer shall conform to IS 5660 : 1970.

Mild steel rounds and flats shall conform to grade Fe 310-O ( Se-32-0 ) of IS 1977 : 1975 and Sections shall conform to IS 1732: 1989 or IS 1730 : 1989. 3.4 Mild Steel Sheets Mild steel sheets shall conform to Grade IS 513 : 1986 or Grade 0 of IS 1079 : 1988. 3.5 Mild Steel Tubes Mild steel tubes shall conform to IS 7138 : 1973. 3.6 Screws Screws shall conform to IS 1365 : 1978. 3.7 Steel Wires Steel wires where used shall be steel wire for springs conforming to Grade 1 of IS 4454 (Part 1 ) : 1981. 4 DIMENSIONS

The finish shall Abefree from all visible defects and the film shall not chip when tapped lightly with a dull pointed instrument. 6.5 All other components shall be finished in colour as agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 6.6 Powder coating as specified in IS 13871 : 1993 may be done on mild steel components if required by the purchaser.
